description: Grungy, distorted 808s and synth basses that stay full: the Dirt section distorts the top while Sub Keep blends the clean sub back underneath. 101 presets in Travis Scott, Mike Dean, untiljapan, Ye, Yeezus, KING, moshc0re, SAFE, trip-hop and 80s styles, plus regular bouncy 808s.
highlights: 808 body with punch, warmth and knock, plus two unison synth oscillators
Moog-style ladder filter, glide, release dive, tempo-synced LFO
8 distortion types at 4x oversampling with Sub Keep for heavy-but-full low end
Chorus, delay and space on the top only, so the sub stays mono
POLY switch: play chords with any preset (it stays put when you change presets)
installTips: Notes play at real pitch: the classic 808 range is C2–C3 in FL's piano roll (or use the Octave knob).

items: 80s category, 7 new basses: the Push It To The Limit octave bass, a Moroder echo pulse, the driving pick bass of I'm Still Standing, synth-funk, a Minimoog, an arena overdrive (extreme) and a soft Moog sub (subtle)

New look, matching the rawleads instrument design: a DARK / LITE switch in the top bar (every open plugin follows it, with a soft crossfade), keycap buttons that press in, the preset name on a lit smoked-amber key with a flickering lamp behind it, LED switches, glowing knob arcs, console displays and the Instrument Sans typeface
